query:
SELECT 
  LENGTH(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wowReportJson, '$.lifeHistoryPattern'))) as totalLen,
  INSTR(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wowReportJson, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')), '## Recurring') as recurringPos,
  INSTR(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wowReportJson, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')), CHAR(10)) as firstNewlinePos,
  INSTR(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wowReportJson, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')), CHAR(13)) as firstCRPos,
  SUBSTRING(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wowReportJson, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')), 1, 500) as preview500
FROM analysis_reports WHERE clientId = 870001 ORDER BY generatedAt DESC LIMIT 1
